newsitem.title: FINLAND: HANDELSBANKEN DERIVATIVES BROKING UNCHANGED - SOM.
newsitem.headline: HANDELSBANKEN DERIVATIVES BROKING UNCHANGED - SOM.

text.p: The Finnish options exchange (SOM) said on Thursday that Swedish Handelsbanken's move to halt its equity market-making on the SOM exchange did not effect Handelsbanken's broking in SOM's equity and fixed-income derivatives.

The bank's "decision to put its market-making on hold until further notice concerning both FOX index derivatives and STOX stock derivatives has no effect on Handelsbanken's broking activities in SOM's equity- and fixed-income derivatives," SOM said.
"The decision has no effect on Handelsbanken's market-making activities in fixed-income products," it added.
At Handelsbanken in Helsinki, Patrik Hertsberg, head of equities, declined comment.

After Handelsbanken discontinued its market-making in FOX and STOX derivatives, the SOM exchange has five market makers in equity derivatives and four in debt and money market instruments, a SOM official said.
